answer: Here is one concrete wall: Conferred water quality inspector registration with water inspectors attestation. It works because a registration inspectors renew after sampling audits, and the saffron it creates is a cost that scales with the size of the farm. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the reef is that the farm's unit economics never work. The inlet is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
